name: USDA NIFA
collect_note: Open and upcoming USDA NIFA calls are read from Grants.gov twice a day and kept only when the title says Hispanic-Serving or Hispanic Serving (the HSI Education Grants). The deadline comes from the posting. Currently one call, closing December 3, 2026.
evidence: Plain HTTP (python urllib, desktop UA): POST https://api.grants.gov/v1/api/search2 with {rows:25, oppStatuses:forecasted|posted, agencies:USDA-NIFA, keyword:Hispanic-Serving} returned 3 hits, of which USDA-NIFA-HSI-011903 (posted, close 12/03/2026, open 09/10/2026, CFDA 10.223) is the HSI call; the other two are AFRI calls dropped by the title filter. Probes also showed aln:10.223 returns unrelated HHS hits (key ignored). NIFA page https://www.nifa.usda.gov/grants/funding-opportunities/hispanic-serving-institutions-education-grants-program returned HTTP 200 with the same dates; checked 2026-11-12.
